prompts.soviet_rouble: Create ONE production currency icon for a Hearts of Iron IV Cold War UI, matching the supplied icon family. Image 1 is the current rouble icon and is a STYLE/footprint reference only: replace its modern crossed P currency symbol entirely. Image 2 is the newly approved DDR currency icon, a close STYLE reference for the embossed metal detail. Image 3 is the Chinese yuan style reference. Subject: a Soviet rouble coin motif appropriate to 1970: a bold raised antique-gold Soviet hammer and sickle over a subtly indicated globe, flanked by a compact wheat wreath, with a small five-point star above. This is a Soviet emblem, NOT the DDR hammer and compass; absolutely no compass. Use a circular beveled silver-steel rim, recessed muted deep red coin field, upper-left highlights and lower-right dark edge, matching the chunky hand-painted 3D strategy-game look of the references. Simplify the wreath and globe so the hammer and sickle remain dominant at only 58 pixels. Straight-on, centered, full circular rim visible, tight soft shadow, square transparent canvas with a little clear padding. No modern ₽, no letters, no inscription, no date, no extra objects, no square background, no white matte. Genuine transparent alpha outside the coin.
prompts.guilder: Edit image 1, the existing Dutch guilder currency icon, for use in the SAME game UI. Its proper gold lowercase florin symbol ƒ, brown/bronze recessed circular coin field, raised silver steel rim, upper-left highlights, overall shape and composition MUST be retained. Remove the stray white square corners and white/brown rectangular artifacts outside the circular coin and restore a clean continuous rim where they overlap. Redraw cleanly enough to avoid jagged edges at 72x64 while retaining the existing restrained colors and simple embossed hand-painted 3D style. Images 2 and 3 are supporting STYLE references only. One centered front-facing guilder coin, full rim visible, transparent square canvas, small clear padding. Outside the round coin and its tight shadow must be genuinely transparent. Do not change ƒ to F, £ or €, do not add letters, dates, emblems, decorative backgrounds, a white matte, a display stand or extra coins.
